verdict.rationale: Decagon's 'Proactive Agents' can carry conversation history across sessions and initiate calls/outreach based on customer signals without a human triggering each instance, and AOPs let teams define autonomous agent behavior that runs continuously handling chat/voice/email interactions (decagon-docs-22, decagon-docs-23, decagon-docs-16, decagon-docs-13/14/15). This is autonomous background operation in the customer-support sense, but there's no evidence of a general-purpose 'automation builder' with schedules/triggers/conditions typical of the 'automations' framing, nor independent confirmation of reliability. Missing for 10: explicit trigger/schedule configuration UI, evidence of autonomous multi-step task chains beyond conversation handling, and third-party corroboration of background execution reliability.
